Hi Diego,

I'm Amina, lead researcher at Kenya Language Lab (we're a small nonprofit focused on low-resource African languages). We're ramping a Swahili language model evaluation and data collection project for educational chat agents across Kenyan schools. Budget is very tight for this pilot — we have external academic collaborators but no commercial funding for compute.

Would Redwood consider a promotional credit allocation (trial extension or research grant) so we can run evaluation workloads and a small fine-tune? We're aiming for ~15k tokens/day for three months to collect prompts and run evaluations. I've attached a short proposal, our nonprofit registration, and a sponsor letter from the University of Nairobi.

Key asks:
- $5k–$10k in platform credits or a 3-month trial extension at an academic/research rate
- Assurance that data used for evaluation can be kept private under a research agreement

Happy to provide any additional paperwork — ethics approvals, COI statements, or a short call demo of our planned eval harness.

Thanks for considering — this would directly enable deployment into several pilot classrooms.

Hi Amina — thanks for the detailed note and for sending the proposal. Really interesting work and exactly the kind of low-resource research we want to support.

Quick answers up front:
- We can consider a promotional credit allocation or a trial extension for verified academic or nonprofit projects.
- We typically request nonprofit registration + a short sponsor letter (you already attached those, thanks) and a short security/data-handling note outlining how data will be managed.

I've looped in Marissa (partnerships) and Rishi (grants & discounts) to review scope and approve an initial credit amount. Marissa/Rishi — proposed ask from Amina: 3 months, ~15k tokens/day — rough token estimate ~1.35M tokens/month, total ~4M tokens. Recommendation from me: start with a $7,500 credit (equivalent to our standard research grant band), with a 90-day review and a one-time 30% discount if they provide a short case study and telemetry for quality monitoring.

Amina — can you add a one-paragraph data handling note (where data is stored, who has access, plans for deletion/anonymization)? Once we have that, I'll start the internal approval thread. If it's helpful, I can also schedule a quick call with Marissa to talk about partner programs.

Best,
